titanSays.line: 📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Eater hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.
🔭 Scouts come back pale. The sky looks wrong. Not cloudy, not dark — just... bigger. Like it's closer than it should be.
📻 The old ones point at the horizon and don't speak. The System, for once, is quiet too. Then: the Herald. It heralds the apocalypse the way dawn heralds the day.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 7,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Nostalgia, The Herald, The Eulogy, Big Big, The Reunion) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — The Herald came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.

🚨 Nostalgia, The Herald, The Eulogy, Big Big, The Reunion is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
One of them is coming for YOU — The Herald, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.

⛔ THE HERALD does not notice you the way prey notices a hunter. It notices you the way weather notices a field. You cannot face this alone — sound the call, muster 10 allied blades (you have 0). This is not courage. This is arithmetic.
